text_simplified: This unit explains how to instill values and principles in children through good *qudwa* (exemplary conduct) and active participation. It aims to transform *tarbiyah* from mere theoretical instruction into a practical practice that the child feels in their daily behavior. The unit reviews the model of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in the *tarbiyah* of the *Sahabah* (Companions) and involving them in *da'wah* (calling to Islam) tasks. It also emphasizes the importance of involving parents and the family in the *tarbiyah* process to strengthen religious belonging.
